methodology: Unsigned packaged app, isolated fresh profile for each of three launches. Launch-to-interactive waits for the production welcome heading, role controls and two animation frames. Idle RSS is sampled 15 seconds later. Profiling disables background throttling through the main-process inspector so screen sleep/occlusion cannot stall animation-frame samples. Sum of OS working sets/RSS for the app process tree (shared pages can count more than once). Five-second sampled peak, no forced GC. A profiling-only display-sleep blocker and 16-ms timer-paced animation callbacks keep the memory soak running independently of display vsync; renderer latency is measured separately with native animation frames. Main process remains running during a synthetic production-renderer stream; no model/provider is invoked.
